summary: Allow decode context parallelism equal to tensor parallelism for official Qwen3.8-Flash-Next checkpoints
details: Checkpoints that declare model_type qwen4_exp, including the official FP8 and NVFP4 releases, now start at TP4/DCP4 instead of failing with "decode-context-parallel-size (4) exceeds the maximum supported value (2)".
Decode context parallelism still requires the B12X QSA backend.
